The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d97ba60373419ba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The chart and metric conclusions have the following two variants. (i) The same tailorable bounded complement and homogeneous chart argument works if we are working over an algebraically closed generic field, with the relevant effective CYs on a Q-factorial model of Fano type, and have boundedness only up to isomorphism in codimension one of these models. (ii) A Cartier rational b-order function N with effective trace of degree O(ξ) on the bounded model, b-linearly Q-equivalent to a difference of b-nef parts both of trace degrees O(ξ), has horizontal Lipschitz constant O(ξ), including when ξ → 0+.
